341:t_1:3.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
(...I hear... a voice... a woman's voice...)

341:t_1:5.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
(No... This sorrowful voice isn't just $$リリーナ$$'s...)

341:t_1:6.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
(I can feel it... People's wills... their feelings, spreading through space...)

341:t_1:7.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
(They seek peace beyond the fighting... And the one that will open that path is...)

341:t_2:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...So everyone who was there has been taken aboard this transport ship.」

341:t_2:5.en:
$$デュオ$$
「That was close. Some of our machines would've been in real trouble if we'd suddenly been dumped into space.」

341:t_2:6.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「So... Have you found out where we are?」

341:t_2:7.en:
$$カレン$$
「It looks like $$ＡＧ$$ has an explanation about that.」

341:t_2:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Everyone, thank you very much for gathering here despite your busy schedules.」

341:t_2:9.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Spare us the pointless preamble and explain the situation now.」

341:t_2:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Your anger is quite understandable. Then I shall explain at once.」

341:t_2:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「According to this ship's navigation system and my personal super-dimensional sensor, we are at the center of the galaxy.」

341:t_2:12.en:
$$スザク$$
「We're at the center of the galaxy...」

341:t_2:13.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「You mean the center of our galaxy...」

341:t_2:14.en:
$$クルツ$$
「Then we've been thrown right into the middle of the galaxy, just like the rest of $c!?」

341:t_2:15.en:
$$マオ$$
「I hear Earth is about 30,000 light-years from the center of our galaxy...」

341:t_2:16.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「You're saying we crossed that distance in an instant...」

341:t_2:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「One moment, please. We may have traveled more than just a physical distance.」

341:t_2:18.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The location sensor indicates the galactic center, but judging from our surroundings, this seems to be somewhere other than our galaxy, the Milky Way.」

341:t_2:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes. It is highly likely we have been transported to another parallel world.」

341:t_2:21.en:
$$マオ$$
「Isn't that strange? Your sensor is pointing to the center of the galaxy, right?」

341:t_2:23.en:
$$桂$$
「You're being awfully evasive. You're a dimensional merchant who travels between parallel worlds, and you don't know about this?」

341:t_2:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「No... After all, even we at $$ＤＥＭ$$ do not understand the galactic center...」

341:t_2:25.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「What do you mean by that?」

341:t_2:26.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Actually, in each parallel world, conditions at the center of the Milky Way are impossible to observe.」

341:t_2:27.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「This also applies to your worlds, $$ＵＣＷ$$ and $$ＡＤＷ$$, and naturally to the world formed by their fusion.」

341:t_2:28.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The only exception I know is the world where $$タカヤ・ノリコ$$ lived.」

341:t_2:29.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「That's the world that was subjected to attacks by $$宇宙怪獣$$...」

341:t_2:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Only there has a $$宇宙怪獣$$ nest been confirmed at the galactic center.」

341:t_2:31.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then, since $$宇宙怪獣$$ also exist in our world, is their nest at our galactic center too?」

341:t_2:32.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I considered that too, but at least in this area, there appears to be no such thing.」

341:t_2:33.en:
$$カレン$$
「Then we really have... traveled to a parallel world...」

341:t_2:34.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「Hey, $$ＡＧ$$... Can we... get back to Earth?」

341:t_2:37.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...This is a secondhand transport ship. Forget hyperspace navigation; even its ability to travel between planets is questionable...」

341:t_2:44.en:
$n
「First, broadcast a call to the surrounding area. At the same time, contact $$ＤＥＭ$$ headquarters and request a rescue for us.」

341:t_2:45.en:
$n
「If that fails, have a space-time transfer device sent here. On your pride as a dimensional merchant, find some way for us to return to Earth.」

341:t_2:47.en:
$n
「We can launch $$ジェニオン$$, right? I'll explore the area with the machines that can operate.」

341:t_2:49.en:
$n
「It's just as I said back then, Miss $$スズネ$$.」

341:t_2:50.en:
$n
「All I can do for others is wait, but when it comes to myself, I'll do everything I can until the very end.」

341:t_2:51.en:
$$宗介$$
「I'll join you, $n. We have reasons we must return to Earth.」

341:t_2:52.en:
$$クルツ$$
「That's right. We don't have time to sit around here.」

341:t_2:53.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「If we were able to come here, we can surely return too.」

341:t_2:55.en:
$$カレン$$
「Don't do that, $$テイタニア$$. At times like this, we have to muster all our fighting spirit first.」

341:t_2:56.en:
$$キリコ$$
「Save your despair until after you're dead. That's the kind of people gathered here.」

341:t_2:58.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「$$テイタニア$$... If you've decided to walk alongside $$キリコ$$, make up your mind.」

341:t_2:59.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「He moves forward, pulling everyone around him along. Go with him.」

341:t_2:60.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「Are you the same, $$クエント$$ian?」

341:t_2:62.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「And like you, I chose this way of life because I wanted to.」

341:t_2:64.en:
$$カレン$$
「You finally smiled, $$テイタニア$$.」

341:t_2:65.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「Good grief... At least I never have to worry about being bored here.」

341:t_2:67.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「Heh... A soldier's life shaped by discipline and orders has turned into a thrilling adventure on the sea of stars... That isn't bad either.」

341:t_2:69.en:
$$ルルーシュ$$
「We will live with all our strength until our final moment!」
